name: Yitong Zeng
bio_short: BSD Lab alum continuing her research training at the University of Bologna under Prof. Vincenzo Romei.
bio_long: Yitong Zeng completed her master's training in Fundamental Psychology at South China Normal University, studying neural oscillations in time perception and motor timing with EEG, iEEG, and non-invasive brain stimulation. She is continuing her research training at the University of Bologna under the supervision of Prof. Vincenzo Romei.
